purpose: Use the user's existing MARKET_AI_HUB Yuanta implementation as the read-only exact JNU data bridge. Do not create a duplicate broker login or credential path in JNU Research.

instrument.exact_contract_requirement: Use the exact Yuanta StockCode for the active individual contract month. Never substitute a continuous symbol.
instrument.stock_code_discovery: Resolve dynamically from the current Yuanta FunctionList / verified contract resolver. Observed exact formats are JNU<YYMM> for day and JNUPM<YYMM> for night; examples must not be hardcoded.

validation_gates: MARKET_AI_HUB owner/recorder is healthy and not duplicated.
Exact JNU individual-month StockCode is verified.
Exact quote/tick callback identity matches OSE MarketNo=207 and requested JNU contract.
Depth may be used only after a real SubscribeFiveTickA callback is observed and fresh; assume five levels from public documentation, and enable deeper levels only with explicit runtime evidence.
Provider timestamps/sequence are captured and pass the selected mode freshness rules.
No trade/order API call is exposed through the JNU Research path.

jpX_research_result.free_trial: OSE may offer one-month real-time market-data trial for internal evaluation; historical tick sample/trial may be available subject to conditions.

single_owner_rule: Never create a second Yuanta broker login while an existing verified quote owner is RUNNING/DEGRADED with startup_stage RUNNING. Consume its local snapshot/Parquet/control path read-only instead.

local_implementation.credential_store: Windows Credential Manager through MARKET_AI_HUB credential_store.py
local_implementation.rule: Reuse existing single owner. No parallel JNU Research login.
